title: No correction by tab "Treatments"
symptom: After updating to 3.1.0.3-dev-a, the user can no longer delete or correct an incorrect bolus entry using the 'Treatments' button. Clicking the trash can icon does nothing; no selection checkboxes appear.
cause: A regression introduced in a recent development version broke the delete functionality in the Treatments screen.
fix: The fix was implemented by Milos in commit 0ccc5bf. Users should update to a version that includes this commit.
